description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer interface, including embedded CSS styling and JavaScript for dynamic behavior to browse and view database tables and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets view states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for a data table based on fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding and collapsing cell content for full display.
